outcome: Original 41st National Film Awards catalogue entry visually verified in Hindi and English: Bir is credited with script and the embedded Kedar–Gouri tale is described as popular in jatras. It does not identify a separate literary source author; this omission does not disprove a written source. An official Sahitya Akademi annual-report page verifies Archana Nayak’s 98-page Odia study of Mohapatra Nilamani Sahoo, ISBN 978-93-91494-77-3. The monograph itself was not read. Nilamani Sahu remains an unresolved secondary-source/metadata lead for Lavanya Preeti; no exact original story or original credit obtained. All 70 protected public-source, binding, asset and book-proof hashes unchanged. Research-only; no public revision, rebuild, publication or human approval.
